items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: One flat monthly fee, paid by the nursery. Book a demo and we will go through the details with you.

items.question: Do parents pay anything?
items.answer: No, never. Parents use the app for free. The nursery pays.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Book a 30-minute demo. We show you Yawmy Care with your own nursery in mind, then set it up with you within 48 hours.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Within 48 hours. Book a 30-minute demo, then we set up your nursery with you: classes, children and teachers. You invite parents and start your first day.

items.question: Do my teachers need training?
items.answer: No formal training. The screens are simple, and we walk your team through the basics during setup.

items.question: How does check-in work?
items.answer: Parents check in and out from the gate in one tap, within a distance you set. Teachers can also mark a child in by hand.

items.question: What do parents see in the app?
items.answer: The child's day: meals, nap, mood, photos and announcements, without having to message anyone. They can also chat with the nursery in the app.

items.question: Can we stop using WhatsApp and Excel?
items.answer: Yes. Most nurseries start there, so we help you bring your existing lists across during setup. Attendance, daily updates and parent messages then live in one place.

items.question: Is the app available in Arabic?
items.answer: Yes, in Arabic and English. Switch language anytime.

items.question: We run a nursery inside a school. Is Yawmy Care a fit?
items.answer: Yes. Yawmy Care is built for private nurseries and international schools, including a nursery or early-years section inside a school. Talk to us and we will show you how it fits your setup.
